def circular_shift(x, shift):
    """Circular shift the digits of the integer x, shift the digits right by shift
    and return the result as a string.
    If shift > number of digits, return digits reversed.
    >>> circular_shift(12, 1)
    "21"
    >>> circular_shift(12, 2)
    "12"
    """
    s = str(x)
    n = len(s)
    shift %= n
    if shift == 0:
        return s
    # Right circular shift by `shift`: last `shift` digits move to the front.
    return s[-shift:] + s[:-shift] if shift < n else s[::-1]
```

def circular_shift(x, shift):
    """Circular shift the digits of the integer x, shift the digits right by shift
    and return the result as a string.
    If shift > number of digits, return digits reversed.
    >>> circular_shift(12, 1)
    "21"
    >>> circular_shift(12, 2)
    "12"
    """
    s = str(x)
    n = len(s)
    shift %= n
    if shift == 0:
        return s
    # Right circular shift by `shift`: last `shift` digits move to the front.
    return s[-shift:] + s[:-shift] if shift < n else s[::-1]
